title: Kris Jenner Hug at Met Gala Afterparty Goes Viral; Camila Morrone Joke Surfaces
detail: The day after the 2026 Met Gala, video of Bad Bunny hugging Kris Jenner on the red carpet went viral across TikTok and X. In the footage — widely shared by TMZ, Just Jared, and E! Online — Kris Jenner appeared not to immediately recognize Bad Bunny in his hyper-realistic aged prosthetics, creating an awkwardly endearing encounter as Kim Kardashian looked on. The clip racked up tens of millions of views within hours and sparked debate over whether the hug was 'awkward' or simply warm. On the same day, model and actress Camila Morrone appeared to joke in an Instagram Stories clip published by Hola at approximately 12:30 PM EDT that she 'talked to Bad Bunny, he's not interested' — prompting fresh tabloid speculation. The viral moments extended Bad Bunny's Met Gala cultural footprint well beyond the event itself and reinforced his status as a tabloid fixture at the intersection of music, fashion, and celebrity.
